proxyPools.col.label: Label
proxyPools.default.description: Your own sensors send scans to public targets through these proxies. Private addresses are still scanned directly. A sensor can use another pool or go direct on its page. Shared sensors never use your proxies.
proxyPools.default.name: Organization default
proxyPools.default.needsProxy: Add at least one proxy before turning proxies on: scans fail closed when the pool has none.
proxyPools.default.title: Use proxies for scans
proxyPools.deleteDesc: Delete "{name}" and its proxies? Their stored credentials are erased.
proxyPools.deleteInUse: Sensors still use this pool. Set their network path to another pool, Direct or Inherit first.
proxyPools.dialog.description: A pool is a list of proxies. Assign it to sensors on their pages: a sensor assigned a pool sends all its scan traffic through it, private targets included.
proxyPools.dialog.needsProxy: Add at least one proxy before enabling the pool: scans fail closed when it has none.
proxyPools.error.inUse: Sensors still use this pool. Set those sensors to another network path (or Direct) on their pages, then delete the pool.
proxyPools.error.invalidEndpointHint: Fix the line and save again. Format: scheme://user:pass@host:port#label
proxyPools.field.name: Name
proxyPools.more.description: Pools for one network segment or a few sensors. Pick them on a sensor under Network path.
proxyPools.more.emptyDescription: Add a pool when a sensor in a network segment must reach its targets through its own proxy.
proxyPools.more.title: More pools
proxyPools.noDelete: You need the sensors:egress:delete permission to delete pools
proxyPools.noWrite: You need the sensors:egress:write permission to change pools
proxyPools.page.description: Send scan traffic from your own sensors through proxies you control. Endpoints are health-checked from real scan traffic; a failing proxy is set aside and tried again later. Scans never fall back to a direct connection while a pool applies.
proxyPools.paste.help: Schemes: http, https, socks5, socks5h (socks5h resolves host names at the proxy). Order is priority. Credentials are encrypted and write-only: they show as •••• after saving. Keep •••• to keep the stored password, type new ones to replace them, and leave them out for none.
proxyPools.paste.label: Paste proxies, one per line
proxyPools.readOnly: You can view proxies but not change them: that needs the sensors:egress:write permission.
proxyPools.sensor.directDesc: The organization's proxies are on. A direct sensor sends its scan traffic from its own address, around them.
proxyPools.sensor.help: A pool chosen here carries all of this sensor's scan traffic. The organization default only carries public targets. A sensor needs a recent version with network confinement to run proxied scans: without it, the sensor receives no scan jobs while a pool applies to it. It never falls back to a direct connection.
proxyPools.sensor.loadFailed: Could not load the network path.
proxyPools.sensor.saveFailed: Could not save the network path
proxyPools.sensor.title: Network path
proxyPools.strategy.priority: Priority: use the first healthy proxy in list order
proxyPools.strategy.sticky: Sticky: spread by health, keep a target on one proxy
proxyPools.title: Proxies
